label: Square stock items
description: One record per Square variation that the app found by its SKU. A linked pair shares its stock: the record remembers the quantity both sides held after the last sync, and the step in progress, so a change on either side is passed on once.

key.label: Key
key.description: Square location and variation. Unique, so a variation has one record per location.

reason.label: Note
reason.description: Why the pair is not linked, or what stopped its sync.

start.label: Starting stock from
start.description: Set while a start is waiting: the side whose quantity both sides take.

agreed.label: Stock in sync
agreed.description: The quantity both sides held after the last sync.

marked.label: Waiting for a sync
marked.description: Set when a change was announced on either side, cleared when a sync looks at the pair.

step.label: Step in progress
step.description: Written before a change is passed on and removed after both sides have it. A sync that was cut short repeats it exactly.

date_read.label: Stock read at
date_read.description: When the last sync read the quantities. Changes after it belong to the next sync.

entry_id.label: Last stock entry
entry_id.description: The Swell stock entry the app wrote last for the pair. It is the app's own change, not one to pass on.

swell_location.label: Swell stock location
swell_location.description: The Swell stock location the pair was started with, in stores that keep stock by location.
